comment: Hand-maintained workflow pins for the BuildRight portfolio register (workflow-coverage/). Every workflow of the erpplans corpus that the e2e suite corpus actually executes is pinned here by name — a pin claims the workflow's core cycle runs green in CI, with the note carrying the honest scope. Everything not listed here derives its state from the requirement claims (requirements-coverage/coverage.json via the upstream requirement-workflow-matrix): a workflow whose primary-linked requirement is claimed is 'partial' with that requirement's evidence; everything else is 'uncovered' — wave-attributed where the upstream requirement-workflow matrix links them (honestly null where it does not yet). Suite paths are repo-root-relative and must exist — on this map and on the generated register alike: the register gate enforces existence and corpus membership on both, and the map may not drift from the register (an edit here must ship with its regeneration; run scripts/generate-workflow-coverage.py).

W2.note: The PO cycle's DRAFT→SUBMITTED→APPROVED spine with line integrity rides the full-cycle case; the PO close step itself is unsuite-pinned (wave 2, per PUR-001's evidence)

W2A.note: The approval-tier branch: threshold gate (mode-all), the requester's task-access denial, reject→resubmit→re-approve, below-threshold auto-approval; multi-level escalation is the platform deferral (PLAN §1) and the auto-replenishment cycle is wave 2+

W3.note: DC receiving: receipt posting with costing on post, validation gates at the door, terminal freeze (frozen receipt rejects updates and deletes), receipt-vs-PO quantity edges

W7.note: AP invoice processing: vendor bill → auto-journal (submitForPosting, JE balanced + frozen) → approval → settlement by posted-payment roll-up; bill validation edges and the BR-G-2 overpay pin; the hard 3-way match guard is BR-G-2's logged gap (approval gate is the compensating control)

W8.note: AR processing: invoice → approval → auto-journal → POSTED → settlement (aging reconciles), credit-note allocation, dunning mirroring its aging bucket, document-currency FX posting in book currency, the bank-feed webhook payment, and the document edges (validation at the door, rejected-invoice-creates-no-journal, role walls, overpayment without allocation per G-3/G-9)

W9.note: The period control legs are pinned (controls suite: soft close, absolute lock, reopen) but the workflow's close-checklist core is gap-logged (ERP G-10/G-11 — the parallel close tasks and controller confirmation are wave-2 platform work), and year-end close is not implemented

W9A.note: Month-end close: period CLOSING→CLOSED→OPEN edges with the closeJournal exemption, trial balance nets zero after the full book→approval→posting→settlement cycle, the WAC verification leg (inventory value = qty × running average)

W308.note: Fiscal calendar & posting period master: the AccountingPeriod machine admits only its listed edges, CLOSING blocks dated postings unless the entry carries closeJournal, CLOSED activates the absolute lock, the reopen re-admits writes
